cumleler: On foam with eyes closed, which system keeps you balanced?
Balance relies on vision, the vestibular system and body sense.
With eyes closed, visual information drops out.
On foam, information from the soles and joints is reduced.
Balance then depends mostly on the vestibular system.
The fourth condition of the mCTSIB tests exactly this.
